terms.title: Content standards
terms.intro: Spaces are for Christian, Bible-centred writing. By continuing you agree to keep what you publish here within that:
terms.rule1: Scripture, reflection, prayer and teaching rooted in the Bible.
terms.rule2: No worldly, political or commercial content.
terms.rule3: No sexual content or nudity, and no dating or romantic solicitation.
terms.rule4: No hate, harassment or abuse of anyone.
terms.rule5: Nothing off-theme — anything that doesn't fit the Bible focus belongs elsewhere.
terms.moderation: Moderators may remove any content, space or account at their own discretion, without notice.
terms.tools: You can report anything that breaks these rules, and block an author — which removes all of their spaces from your app.
terms.accept: I have read and accept the content standards
terms.gateBody: The community now has written standards. Accept them to carry on publishing and reading, or leave the community — your own writing stays on this device either way.

moderation.refusedHint: Edit the piece and publish again. The draft is saved.
moderation.refusedGeneric: This piece doesn't fit the content standards for spaces.
